daemon.not-connected: Can't connect to the daemon (vpnd). Relaunch the daemon or restart the app.
daemon.auth-denied: Authentication required. Click the Authenticate button to secure your connection.

tunnel.internal: Something went wrong. Try again. If it persists, contact support and include your logs.
tunnel.firewall: Couldn't set up NymVPN's firewall rules. Reconnect. If it persists, close other VPN/firewall apps or contact support.
tunnel.routing: Couldn't set up network routing. Reconnect. If it persists, close other VPN apps or contact support.
tunnel.dns: Couldn't apply DNS settings. Reconnect. If it persists, run diagnostics in Settings or contact support.
tunnel.same-entry-exit-gw: Entry and exit can't be the same server. Pick a different entry or exit, then connect again.
tunnel.invalid-entry-gw-country: No entry servers are available in that location. Choose a different location, then connect again.
tunnel.invalid-exit-gw-country: No exit servers are available in that location. Choose a different location, then connect again.
tunnel.invalid-entry-gw-id: The entry server you chose isn't available. Choose a different entry server, then connect again.
tunnel.invalid-exit-gw-id: The exit server you chose isn't available with your current settings. Choose a different exit or entry server, then connect again.
tunnel.credential-wasted-entry-gw: The entry server didn't complete your connection. Try again, or turn on QUIC in Anti-censorship settings.
tunnel.credential-wasted-exit-gw: The exit server didn't complete your connection. Choose a different exit location and try again.
tunnel.performant-entry-gw-unavailable: No entry server is available for your selection. Pick another location, or try again in a few minutes.
tunnel.performant-exit-gw-unavailable: No exit server is available for your selection. Pick a different location, or try again in a few minutes.
tunnel.max-devices-reached: You've hit your device limit. Remove a device on nym.com or log out elsewhere, then reconnect.
tunnel.bandwidth-exceeded: You've reached today's allowance. It resets daily; see Account Status for the time.
tunnel.subscription-expired: You don't have an active subscription. Get or renew a plan, then refresh your account and reconnect.
tunnel.ipv6-unavailable: IPv6 is turned off on this system, but NymVPN is set to use it. Turn off IPv6 in NymVPN settings, then connect again.
tunnel.tun-device: Couldn't set up the VPN network interface. Reconnect. If it persists, restart the app or your device, or contact support.
tunnel.tunnel-provider: Couldn't start the VPN on this device. Reconnect, and allow the VPN connection if prompted. If it persists, contact support.
tunnel.inactive-account: Your account isn't active. Open Account and refresh, or contact support.
tunnel.device-logged-out: This device was logged out. Log in again to reconnect.
tunnel.needs-relaxed-independence-criteria: These entry and exit servers aren't fully independent. Choose different servers, or connect anyway.
tunnel.needs-device-location: Automatic routing isn't available right now. Try again later or choose your own servers.
tunnel.credential-fetching-failed: Couldn't get your connection credentials. Try again shortly. If it persists, restart the app or contact support.
tunnel.no-credential-available: No connection credentials available. Restart NymVPN and try again. If it persists, contact support.
tunnel.connection-attempts-exceeded: Couldn't connect after several tries. Try another location, or try again in a few minutes.

account.internal: Something went wrong with your account. Try again. If it persists, contact support.
account.max-devices-reached: You've hit your device limit. Remove a device on nym.com or log out elsewhere, then reconnect.
account.bandwidth-exceeded: You've reached today's allowance. It resets daily; see Account Status for the time.
account.invalid-recovery-phrase: That recovery passphrase isn't valid. Check the 24 words and try again.
account.no-account-stored: No account on this device. Add your passphrase to log in again.
account.no-device-stored: This device's key is missing. Log out and log in again to set this device up.
account.existing-account: An account already exists here. Log out first, then add a different account.
account.no-subscription: You don’t have an active plan. Tap Get started to begin anonymous browsing.
account.status-not-active: Your account isn't active. Open Account and refresh, or contact support.
account.offline: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.

countries-request.entry: Failed to fetch the available entry node countries
countries-request.exit: Failed to fetch the available exit node countries
countries-request.fast-mode: Failed to fetch the available countries

split-tunnel.app-invalid: The selected file is not a valid application
split-tunnel.app-duplicate: This app is already in the list

fatal.title: Something went wrong
fatal.description: The app ran into an unexpected problem. Exporting the logs and sharing them with support helps us fix it.
